label: [Mechanism of Keke Tablets in treating post-infection cough based on network pharmacology and metabolomics].
summary: This study aimed to evaluate the therapeutic effect of Keke Tablets(KKP) on post-infectious cough(PIC) in rat models and to explore its potential mechanism of action. PIC models were established through exposure to cigarette smoke, capsaicin atomization, and nasal instillation of lipopolysaccharide.
